evidence.name: Screen field: Edit the wheel's choices
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Edit the wheel's choices" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Edit the wheel's choices
sections.description: The text choices shown on a List-mode wheel. Add, edit, drag to reorder, or delete options (1-20 allowed). The order here is the order users scroll through, so place the most common choices near the top where the starting value lands. Each option is per-language, so translate them if your funnel runs in more than one language.
